lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Sparse grid of large, high-luminance circular clusters distributed posterior to the branchial region, with a primary concentration along the mid-flank longitudinal axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated intensity intersecting primary blobs, creating a grid-like pattern in the central visible section of the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Visible horizontal ridge extending from the post-cranial region across the upper flank, displaying a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance above to shadow below.

other_distinctive_markers: Sinuous, low-contrast light-intensity paths connecting primary spots on the mid-flank; pectoral fin exhibits a dense, regular grid of small circular spots.
